d: li
Operate MHE such as VNA, Reach Truck, Order Picker, Forklift and Pallet Loader safely and efficiently.
li
Load, unload, and move pallets within the warehouse and staging areas.
li
Support inbound and outbound operations, including put-away, picking, replenishment, and dispatch.
li
Ensure accurate placement of stock as per warehouse location system (WMS / manual locations)
li
Assist in order picking and pallet building based on pick lists or system instructions.
li
Follow all warehouse safety rules, SOPs, and equipment operating guidelines.
li
Conduct pre-operational checks of MHE and report any defects immediately.
li
Maintain clean, organized, and hazard-free work areas.
li
Use PPE at all times as per company safety policy.
li
Support cycle counts and physical inventory checks when required.
li
Ensure correct SKU, quantity, and batch handling during picking and loading.
li
Minimize damages and report any discrepancies or product issues.
q: You have at least 2-3 year of experience in warehousing & DC.
Must have a valid driving license in the UAE.
Hands-on experience operating VNA, Reach Truck, Order Picker, and Pallet Loader.
Valid MHE / Forklift Operator License or Certification.
Good understanding of warehouse layouts and racking systems.
You are someone energized by the unknown and look forward to learning each day on the job.
Good communication skills, and always like to be hands-on with several tools.
Additionally, you have robust interpersonal and intercultural skills.

q: 4 - 6 years of experience in logistics, 3PL vendor management, fleet operations, or last-mile delivery.
Proven track record in monitoring 3PL performance, supply acquisition, and fleet KPIs.
Hands-on capability in project coordination, SLA management, and invoice verification.
Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, analytical, and negotiation skills
Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a relevant field is required.
r: Acquire and onboard new 3PL companies to fulfill evolving supply and business needs.
Monitor 3PL operational KPIs and daily performance metrics to maintain service levels.
Provide day-to-day operational support to 3PL suppliers to resolve field issues and delivery obstacles.
Validate 3PL invoices, verify deliverable completion, and coordinate payment releases with Finance.
Manage supply and demand equilibrium within assigned territories to ensure operational efficiency.
Analyze future capacity requirements to proactively activate supply resources on schedule.
Streamline Service Level Agreement (SLA) operational processes for 3PL supplier requests.
Maintain effective working relationships with external suppliers to support smooth logistics operation.
Manage assigned special logistics projects and regional initiatives under managerial guidance.
Align cross-functional teams and corporate departments to ensure smooth project execution.
Track project timelines, scope, cost metrics, and deliverables against quality standards.
Support stakeholder readiness by assisting in training, workshops, and supplier communications during process changes.
Prepare participating teams and partners for operational shifts to maintain high morale and minimal disruption.
Review operational change issues and recommend proper initiatives to maintain a productive work environment
Establish and maintain working relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
Act as an operational representative with local and international stakeholders as directed by the Manager.
Provide functional inputs to the budgeting process during the planning cycle.
Monitor utilization of allocated operational spend and report on budget progress and challenges
Set performance objectives, provide necessary support, evaluate direct reports, and provide regular feedback on performance.
Participate in the identification and recruitment of key talents for the function.
Provide clear direction, prioritize tasks, assign and delegate responsibility, and monitor the workflow.
Provide opportunities for team members to suggest, participate in, and contribute to improvement, innovation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Follow all relevant policies, procedures, and processes for the daily work to be carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
Contribute to the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement of processes and practices to enhance effectiveness.
Uphold a high-performance working environment and promote HS’s Values.
